title: Trauma Orthopaedic Perioperative DVT Risk Calculator
description: A bedside web calculator for predicting perioperative deep vein thrombosis (DVT) risk in trauma orthopaedic inpatients with lower-limb fractures, based on a temporally validated model combining the Caprini score with the thrombus coagulation index (TCI = TAT + TM). Model: logit(P) = -3.8238 + 0.2469 * Caprini + 1.6019 * I(TCI > 24.23); risk = 1/(1 + exp(-logit)). The calculator returns an individualised DVT probability and a risk stratum (low <20% / intermediate 20-30% / high >30%).
